Area.evidence_source: [009_emotions_and_feelings_not_articulated] Failure to acknowledge mental health problems can lead to exacerbation of symptoms. However, men also spoke about instances where they recognized their distress but did not feel comfortable speaking about it. This discomfort was linked to perceptions about socially appropriate and inappropriate male behavior and contributed to fragmented pathways. In particular, men said that it was inappropriate for them to articulate or show their emotions to others and this created difficulty for receiving appropriate care. Disclosure of a mental illness seemed to have a negative or damaging impact on their self-image.
